messages:
sam: starting a quick sync thread for Nimbus POC intake — want to lock down agenda, success criteria, and immediate blockers. propose 4-week trial, can shorten if they want.

maria: thanks — quick context: Nimbus wants LLM-powered search + summarization on private data, red teams flagged SSO + KMS as gating items.

lee: can we confirm scope of data? full DB access or subset of documentation? that affects eval sets and embedding strategy.

sam: asked Nimbus legal — they said: docs + public product pages only for pilot. no PHI. that should simplify KMS asks but still need envelope encryption.

maria: suggested agenda for kickoff (short bullets):
- intros & stakeholders (5m)
- goals & success criteria (10m)
- data access & security Qs (10m)
- demo & integration plan (10m)
- eval metrics + timelines (10m)
- next steps / owners (5m)

lee: success criteria proposal:
- latency: 95th percentile < 400ms for query path
- relevance: top-3 precision >= 78% on their eval set
- summary quality: ROUGE-L baseline vs human >= 0.65
- stability: zero auth/permission errors during demo

taylor: add commercial win criteria: cost per 1k tokens under $0.60 (hosted) or equivalent on Dedicated pricing; and a path to production in 12 weeks.

sam: good call. maria — can you scope prompts & evals? need sample prompts (5-10) + eval rubric from Nimbus prior to kickoff.

maria: on it. will send prompt set by EOD Tue. plan to include retrieval prompts, long-form summarization, and rerank tests.

lee: technical blockers to flag pre-kickoff:
- SSO: Nimbus uses Okta, need SAML config + cert exchange
- KMS: they want customer-managed keys (AWS KMS) — need to confirm support in Private or Dedicated only
- Network: they may require VPC peering for Private deployment

security-bot: checklist item created: SSO (okta) / KMS (customer-key) / Data-residency. ticket: INF-8721. assigned to eng-security.

sam: pricing Q from AE: if they choose Dedicated for production, can we offer a 3-month pilot discount? sales team wants that spelled out in kickoff.

maria: we usually offer 50% off Dedicated for first 90 days on committed capacity pilots — flag in kickoff.

lee: integration plan (tech):
1) initial ingest to sandbox bucket (s3)
2) run embedding pipeline (we provide script + sample config)
3) attach to Redwood hosted endpoint for test queries
4) swap to Dedicated / Private connector if they need CMK / VPC

sam: timeline proposal:
Week 0: kickoff + access setup + prompt collection
Week 1: ingest + embeddings + baseline eval
Week 2: tuning prompts + rerank + latency tuning
Week 3: run formal eval + customer review
Week 4: handoff + production runbook + pricing discussion

maria: owner assignments: sam (AE) — overall; lee (SE) — integration & evals; taylor (product) — success criteria signoff; eng-security — SSO/KMS.

sam: pre-kickoff ask list for Nimbus (send before meeting):
- 5-10 sample queries + expected outputs
- access to sample docs in sandbox S3 (or share via signed link)
- Okta SAML metadata + admin contact
- KMS requirements (CMK ARN if available)
- desired production timeline & budget range

lee: a quick code snippet we'll share for embedding run:
```
python run_embed.py --input s3://nimbus-sandbox/docs --output s3://nimbus-sandbox/embeds --model redwood-embed-v1
```

sam: next steps: I’ll schedule kickoff for Tue 10am PT unless anyone objects. maria — send prompt pack & rubric by Tue EOD. security-bot — ping eng-security to confirm INF-8721 owner.

maria: ack.

security-bot: eng-security notified, assigned to @ana-security.

sam: perfect — thanks team. I’ll drop calendar invite and customer pre-reads.
